practice_units.title: Constructing a Line Parallel to a Given Line
practice_units.problem: Draw a line segment AB of length 6 cm. Take a point C outside AB and construct a line parallel to AB passing through C using a ruler and compass.
guidance: First, draw AB and mark point C.
Pick a point D on AB and join CD.
Draw an arc from D intersecting AB and CD.
With the same radius, draw an arc from C on CD.
Measure the distance between the intersections on the first arc and copy it to the second arc.
Join C and the new intersection point.
practice_units.solution: A line parallel to AB is constructed through C.

practice_units.title: Constructing an Isosceles Triangle
practice_units.problem: Construct an isosceles triangle XYZ where the equal sides XY and XZ are 5 cm each and the angle between them is 60 degrees.
guidance: At X, construct an angle of 60 degrees using a protractor or compass.
On the angle arm, cut an arc of 5 cm from X to find Z.
practice_units.solution: Triangle XYZ is constructed with XY = XZ = 5 cm and ∠YXZ = 60°.
